description: This PHP source file defines the FilterAdminController class within the Goteo project. It provides administrative functionalities for managing filters, including listing, editing, adding, and deleting filter entries in the system. The class extends AbstractAdminController and interacts with the Filter model and form handling components, as well as routing and messaging utilities.

classes.name: FilterAdminController
classes.description: Controller class managing administrative filter functions such as listing, editing, adding, and deleting filter entries within the Goteo application. Extends AbstractAdminController and includes route definitions and action methods for filter management.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name for this controller, which is 'communications'.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns the routing table for filter management actions including list, edit, add, and delete.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of filters from the database and returns a view response to display them.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles creating a new filter or editing an existing one, including form handling and validation.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Deletes a specified filter if it exists and is not in use, after appropriate validation and exception handling.
